datasets.dataset_name: Hyperspectral Imaging for Early Detection of Crown Rot in Wheat
datasets.disease_categories: Crown Rot (Fusarium pseudograminearum) & Combined Drought Stress
datasets.ground_truth_labels: Inoculated (Infected) vs. Mock-inoculated (Control); Watering regime (Drought vs. Well-watered)
datasets.collection_methodology: Indoor phenotyping platform with automated LemnaTec scanalyzer and VNIR/SWIR hyperspectral imager
datasets.publication_reference: Xie, Y.; Plett, D.; Liu, H. The Promise of Hyperspectral Imaging for the Early Detection of Crown Rot in Wheat. AgriEngineering 2021, 3, 924-941. DOI: 10.3390/agriengineering3040057
datasets.dataset_limitations: Tabularized ROI reflectance; full spatial 3D raw cubes require university network credentials
datasets.selection_justification: Direct open access, robust 1,632 samples across 657 continuous bands spanning both VNIR and SWIR, Apache 2.0 license, and explicitly focused on early pre-symptomatic disease forecasting.

datasets.dataset_name: Canopy Hyperspectral Dataset for Tomato Bacterial Wilt Severity Identification
datasets.disease_categories: Bacterial Wilt (Ralstonia solanacearum) across 5 severity grades (Level 0 to Level 4)
datasets.ground_truth_labels: Level 0 (Healthy), Level 1 (Pre-symptomatic/no wilting), Level 2 (1-33%), Level 3 (34-66%), Level 4 (67-100%)
datasets.collection_methodology: Specim IQ handheld hyperspectral camera in dark-room controlled illumination
datasets.publication_reference: Wang, X. et al. Early identification and severity evaluation of tomato bacterial wilt using hyperspectral imaging. Frontiers in Plant Science (2021).
datasets.dataset_limitations: Sample size limited to 293 total canopy scans; packaged in proprietary RAR archive requiring unrar binaries
datasets.selection_justification: Valuable multi-severity progression dataset for secondary validation and domain generalization.

datasets.dataset_name: Hyperspectral Spectroscopic Reflectance of In-Vivo Non-Symptomatic and Symptomatic Kiwi Leaves
datasets.publisher_institution: INESC TEC / University of Porto / Zenodo
datasets.collection_methodology: In-situ field spectroscopic collection with ASD FieldSpec HandHeld 2 spectroradiometer across commercial orchards
datasets.publication_reference: Reis-Pereira, M. et al. In-vivo Proximal Hyperspectral Sensing for Pre-symptomatic Canker Monitoring. Agronomy (2024).
datasets.dataset_limitations: Point spectroscopy on leaf contact probe; does not capture wide canopy 2D spatial context
datasets.selection_justification: Excellent high-resolution spectral benchmark for field-scale pre-symptomatic detection.

datasets.dataset_name: Hyperspectral Imaging of Potato Plants Exposed to Nematode and Drought Stress
datasets.disease_categories: Nematode infestation (Globodera pallida) combined with water-deficit stress
datasets.ground_truth_labels: Inoculated vs Non-inoculated across 4 growth milestones
datasets.collection_methodology: Dual-camera VNIR/SWIR push-broom system in greenhouse conditions
datasets.publication_reference: Lapajne, J. et al. Multi-temporal hyperspectral imaging of potato stress phenotyping. Sensors (2024).
datasets.dataset_limitations: Very large raw image cubes (>45 GB); exceeds lightweight edge deployment bounds
datasets.selection_justification: Detailed dual VNIR/SWIR setup, but massive archive size makes it unsuitable for agile 1-month intern project iteration.

datasets.publisher_institution: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory / Purdue University
datasets.crop_species: Mixed agricultural crops (Vegetables, Grapes, Broccoli, Lettuce, Vineyard)
datasets.collection_methodology: Airborne AVIRIS sensor over Salinas Valley, California
datasets.publication_reference: Baumgardner, M. F. et al. 220 Band AVIRIS Hyperspectral Image Data Set. LARS Technical Reports (1992).
datasets.dataset_limitations: Captures crop taxonomic classification rather than specific plant pathology or disease stages
datasets.selection_justification: Standard baseline benchmark in hyperspectral literature for algorithm validation.
